name: PCI DSS
description: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard v4.0.1 - 12 requirements.

controls.title: Processes for NSCs
controls.objective: Processes and mechanisms for network security controls are defined and understood.

controls.title: NSC configuration
controls.objective: Network security controls are configured and maintained.

controls.title: CDE network access
controls.objective: Network access to and from the cardholder data environment is restricted.

controls.title: Trusted/untrusted connections
controls.objective: Connections between trusted and untrusted networks are controlled.

controls.title: Dual-connected devices
controls.objective: Risks from devices connected to both untrusted networks and the CDE are mitigated.

controls.title: Config processes
controls.objective: Processes and mechanisms for secure configurations are defined and understood.

controls.title: System configuration
controls.objective: System components are configured and managed securely.

controls.title: Wireless configuration
controls.objective: Wireless environments are configured and managed securely.

controls.title: Storage processes
controls.objective: Processes and mechanisms for protecting stored account data are defined.

controls.title: Minimise storage
controls.objective: Storage of account data is kept to a minimum.

controls.title: No SAD after auth
controls.objective: Sensitive authentication data is not stored after authorisation.

controls.title: PAN display
controls.objective: Access to displays of full PAN and copying of PAN is restricted.

controls.title: PAN protection
controls.objective: PAN is secured wherever it is stored.

controls.title: Key protection
controls.objective: Cryptographic keys protecting stored account data are secured.

controls.title: Key management
controls.objective: Key-management processes and procedures are defined and implemented.

controls.title: Transmission processes
controls.objective: Processes and mechanisms for protecting data in transit are defined.

controls.title: Strong cryptography
controls.objective: PAN is protected with strong cryptography during transmission over open networks.

controls.title: Malware processes
controls.objective: Processes and mechanisms for protecting against malware are defined.

controls.title: Malware prevention
controls.objective: Malicious software is prevented, or detected and addressed.

controls.title: Anti-malware upkeep
controls.objective: Anti-malware mechanisms are active, maintained and monitored.

controls.title: Anti-phishing
controls.objective: Anti-phishing mechanisms protect personnel.

controls.title: Development processes
controls.objective: Processes and mechanisms for secure systems and software are defined.

controls.title: Secure development
controls.objective: Bespoke and custom software is developed securely.

controls.title: Vulnerability management
controls.objective: Security vulnerabilities are identified and addressed.

controls.title: Web app protection
controls.objective: Public-facing web applications are protected against attacks.

controls.title: Change management
controls.objective: Changes to system components are managed securely.

categories.name: Req 7 - Restrict Access by Need to Know

controls.title: Access processes
controls.objective: Processes and mechanisms for restricting access are defined.

controls.title: Access assignment
controls.objective: Access to system components and data is defined and assigned appropriately.

controls.title: Access control system
controls.objective: Access is managed via an access-control system.

controls.title: Auth processes
controls.objective: Processes and mechanisms for identification and authentication are defined.

controls.title: User identification
controls.objective: User identities and accounts are strictly managed.

controls.title: Strong authentication
controls.objective: Strong authentication for users is established and managed.

controls.title: MFA for CDE
controls.objective: Multi-factor authentication secures access into the CDE.

controls.title: MFA configuration
controls.objective: MFA systems are configured to prevent misuse.

controls.title: Application/system accounts
controls.objective: Use of application and system accounts and factors is strictly managed.

controls.title: Physical processes
controls.objective: Processes and mechanisms for restricting physical access are defined.

controls.title: Facility access
controls.objective: Physical access controls manage entry into facilities and systems.

controls.title: Personnel/visitor access
controls.objective: Physical access for personnel and visitors is authorised and managed.

controls.title: Media handling
controls.objective: Media with cardholder data is stored, distributed and destroyed securely.

controls.title: POI device protection
controls.objective: Point-of-interaction devices are protected from tampering and substitution.

controls.title: Logging processes
controls.objective: Processes and mechanisms for logging and monitoring are defined.

controls.title: Audit logs
controls.objective: Audit logs support detection of anomalies and suspicious activity.

controls.title: Log protection
controls.objective: Audit logs are protected from destruction and unauthorised modification.

controls.title: Log review
controls.objective: Audit logs are reviewed to identify anomalies or suspicious activity.

controls.title: Log retention
controls.objective: Audit log history is retained and available for analysis.

controls.title: Time synchronisation
controls.objective: Time-synchronisation mechanisms support consistent time settings.

controls.title: Control failure response
controls.objective: Failures of critical security controls are detected and responded to promptly.

controls.title: Testing processes
controls.objective: Processes and mechanisms for regularly testing security are defined.

controls.title: Wireless monitoring
controls.objective: Wireless access points are identified and monitored.

controls.title: Vulnerability scanning
controls.objective: Internal and external vulnerabilities are identified, prioritised and addressed.

controls.title: Penetration testing
controls.objective: Internal and external penetration testing is performed and findings corrected.

controls.title: Intrusion detection
controls.objective: Network intrusions and unexpected file changes are detected and responded to.

controls.title: Payment page monitoring
controls.objective: Unauthorised changes on payment pages are detected and responded to.

controls.title: Security policy
controls.objective: A comprehensive information security policy governs asset protection.

controls.title: Acceptable use
controls.objective: Acceptable-use policies for end-user technologies are defined and implemented.

controls.title: Risk management
controls.objective: Risks to the CDE are formally identified, evaluated and managed.

controls.title: Compliance management
controls.objective: PCI DSS compliance is managed.

controls.title: Scope validation
controls.objective: PCI DSS scope is documented and validated.

controls.title: Security awareness
controls.objective: Security awareness education is an ongoing activity.

controls.title: Personnel screening
controls.objective: Personnel are screened to reduce insider-threat risk.

controls.title: Third-party management
controls.objective: Risk from third-party service provider relationships is managed.

controls.title: TPSP support
controls.objective: Third-party service providers support customer PCI DSS compliance.

controls.title: Incident response
controls.objective: Suspected and confirmed incidents impacting the CDE are responded to immediately.
